args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)

round_money used ROUND_HALF_UP while its docstring and FIN-212 require
banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so tests/test_money.py passes.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but its docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail in the nightly build.

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/money-bankers-rounding` (sha 08d3cd5986): passed.
- Expected values in the test check out under half-even: 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66.

Ref: FIN-212

content.text: I'll start by reading the test and the source file it targets.

The bug is clear: `round_money` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but its docstring and FIN-212 call for `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. I checked the test's expected values against half-even: 2.675 → 2.68 (7 is odd, so it rounds up to the even 8) and 2.665 → 2.66 (6 is already even). Both match. I'll create the branch and make the one-line fix.
